sources.title: Cosplay photography posing tips for when you get stuck
sources.author: COSPLAY MODE editorial staff; named example models Tsukasa Sakurazaki, Ringoame and Yuu; author not identified on the opened page
sources.identity: Specialist cosplay magazine posing article, originally published in the May 2018 issue.
coverage: small prop position as character expression
pose comfort and splitting a difficult held pose into shorter attempts
sources.trust_reason: Established specialist cosplay publication with explicit magazine provenance, named example models and detailed written posing guidance; the accessible article describes the relevant variable directly.
sources.independence_key: COSPLAY MODE editorial staff (2018 pose feature)
sources.read_depth: Opened and read relevant sections on small props (lines 121–127), skirt spread (190–197), and movement comfort (201–206). Linked images were not opened as pixels.
sources.notes: Directly supports a generic hand-held small-prop variable. It does not establish dagger-specific orientation, grip, safety, or relation-to-torso rules; do not infer one. Its skirt examples do not establish wide-sleeve behavior.

sources.title: Cosplay photographer and cosplayer: points for verbal direction
sources.author: COSPLAY MODE editorial staff; no individual byline visible in the opened text
sources.identity: Specialist cosplay magazine article originally published in COSPLAY MODE September 2018, with concrete photographer/cosplayer cue examples.
coverage: feedback loops between photographer and cosplayer
sources.trust_reason: Specialist cosplay publication presents explicit verbal cue examples and corresponding pose outcomes, rather than only a syllabus or image captions.
sources.independence_key: COSPLAY MODE editorial staff (2018 direction feature)
sources.read_depth: Opened and read the article text, including arm/body spacing and camera-height prompt examples (lines 63–109), and its communication framing (238–243). Image pixels were not inspected.
sources.notes: Supports explicit, actionable portrait direction in cosplay. It does not test or prescribe a faster method for crowded Chinese conventions; avoid claiming an event-speed or crowd-specific protocol.

sources.title: Offline sharing: beginner guide to convention photography (Guangzhou Canon Imaging Lounge)
sources.author: Canon China event listing; instructor named as A-Qi (2025) / Chen Ziqi (2024 listing)
sources.identity: Official Canon China showroom event listing for beginner convention-photography sessions in Guangzhou.
sources.trust_reason: Official Canon China event page, but it only lists topics and instructor name, not lesson text or demonstrated technique.
sources.independence_key: Canon China Imaging Lounge event listing
sources.read_depth: Read the event listing lines 421–440; no class recording, handout or detailed instruction was present on the opened page.
sources.notes: Useful discovery lead for local professional teaching; syllabus alone cannot support a crowd workflow, prop framing, or technical rule.

sources.title: Inside the photo area where Coser portraits are made at ChinaJoy
sources.author: Lai Xinlin, Jiefang Daily / Shangguan News
sources.identity: Chinese newspaper photo report about the ChinaJoy photography area; includes observations and photographer/cosplayer captions.
coverage: photographer-cosplayer coordination observed in the field
checking images and costume between shots
sources.trust_reason: Named newspaper reporter and direct event reporting; useful for describing context but not an authored photography lesson.
sources.read_depth: Opened and read the article text and captions (lines 5–29 and 55–72). The prose identifies one featured photographer as a university student and hobbyist, not a professional teacher. Caption-described photographs were not opened as pixels.
sources.notes: Confirms a ChinaJoy photography-zone setting and observed pose communication, but supplies no repeatable crowd-management or short-direction technique. Captions are not treated as instruction or image review.

sources.title: Pugoffka — creator profile
sources.author: Pugoffka
sources.identity: First-person Patreon profile of a Kyiv-based cosplayer and cosplay photographer; profile claims over ten years photographing and over 1,000 cosplay shoots.
coverage: cosplay photography tutorials and lighting schemes advertised
sources.trust_reason: First-person identity and practice history are stated by the photographer; individual detailed tutorial posts are member-locked and were not used as evidence.
sources.read_depth: Read public profile text only. Public post results were locked or exposed titles without teaching text; no specific technique was extracted.
sources.notes: Credible specialist for a later authorized/public full-text lesson review, but this pass did not find accessible full-text evidence for dagger, wig, wide-sleeve or crowded-convention variables.
